message:
You know that one friend who panics at the first sign of a storm? Well, I’ve found that having a plan can really help calm those nerves. I like to keep a few essentials on hand and know what to do when winter weather hits. It’s like having a cozy blanket of preparedness wrapped around you — minus the panic. 

If you’re curious about what to keep in your own storm kit, there’s a handy resource out there that lays it all out for you. It's always good to be ready, but don’t forget to take a deep breath and enjoy a cup of cocoa while you’re at it! ☕️ 

What’s your favorite tip for staying calm during a storm?
